The world when
this product wins
Where we are going, why us and why now, what the product does in three years, and the bets underneath it.
Priya Raman, Head of Product  ·  November 2026
In three years, nobody on a platform team will write a dashboard by hand. The system will tell them what changed and why.
Three shifts that make it possible
Every system now emits structured events
Ten years ago you had to build the pipe. Today the pipe exists; the product is what listens to it.
A model that explains an incident from raw telemetry was science fiction in 2023. It is a demo today.
Fewer people run more systems. The tool that removes the reading wins.
The night it wrote the incident report before I had opened my laptop, I stopped reading dashboards. I have not gone back.
Platform lead, Halden Energy, pilot customer since May
What it does that nothing does today
You ask the dashboard a question
Someone built the panel last year
It shows the metric, not the cause
The incident channel does the reasoning
The system tells you before you ask
Every change correlated to every symptom
The cause named, with the evidence
The fix drafted, waiting for a yes
the right column is the whole product
The system will read, explain, suggest and act. The human keeps the decision.
Every deploy, config change and alert on one timeline. Shipped.
The incident narrative written by the system, from the timeline it already has.
The likely fix, drafted as a change request, with the blast radius shown.
Reversible fixes applied on a yes. The human owns the decision, not the typing.
each step pays for the next
Customers will trust a system that shows its evidence
Every claim links to the trace. If we cannot show it, we do not say it.
Teams do not want a forecast of incidents. They want to understand the one they have.
Customers keep their telemetry. We sell the reading, never the lock-in.
if one falls, the roadmap changes
This is the product we build together next. Argue with the bets before the roadmap locks in December.
the bets are the part to argue with
